evidence.text: AMD drives innovation in high performance and AI computing to solve the world’s most important challenges.
evidence.excerpt: AMD drives innovation in high performance and AI computing to solve the world’s most important challenges.

evidence.text: AMD technology powers billions of experiences across cloud and AI infrastructure, embedded systems, AI PCs and gaming.
evidence.excerpt: AMD technology powers billions of experiences across cloud and AI infrastructure, embedded systems, AI PCs and gaming.

evidence.text: With a broad portfolio of AI-optimized CPUs, GPUs, networking and software, AMD delivers full-stack solutions that help customers turn data into breakthroughs.
evidence.excerpt: With a broad portfolio of AI-optimized CPUs, GPUs, networking and software, AMD delivers full-stack solutions that help customers turn data into breakthroughs.

evidence.text: Our high-performance product portfolios provide differentiated solutions, including semi-custom System-on-Chip (SoCs), adaptive SoCs and accelerated processing units (APUs).
evidence.excerpt: Our high-performance product portfolios provide differentiated solutions, including semi-custom System-on-Chip (SoCs), adaptive SoCs and accelerated processing units (APUs).

evidence.text: For data centers, we offer AI accelerators, microprocessors (CPUs), graphic processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), AI Network Interface Cards (AI NICs) and field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs).
evidence.excerpt: For data centers, we offer AI accelerators, microprocessors (CPUs), graphic processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), AI Network Interface Cards (AI NICs) and field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs).

evidence.text: We also offer data center rack-scale platform designs that incorporate AMD data center products to meet the growing performance demands of AI supercomputers and machine learning workloads.
evidence.excerpt: We also offer data center rack-scale platform designs that incorporate AMD data center products to meet the growing performance demands of AI supercomputers and machine learning workloads.

evidence.text: In client computing, our CPUs, APUs and chipsets for desktops and notebooks deliver performance, efficiency, AI capabilities and modern security features for gamers, creators, consumers and enterprises.
evidence.excerpt: In client computing, our CPUs, APUs and chipsets for desktops and notebooks deliver performance, efficiency, AI capabilities and modern security features for gamers, creators, consumers and enterprises.

evidence.text: AMD was the first company to integrate a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) on the same SoC as an x86 CPU for AI PCs.
evidence.excerpt: AMD was the first company to integrate a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) on the same SoC as an x86 CPU for AI PCs.

evidence.text: By bringing NPU‑accelerated AI capabilities directly into mainstream x86 platforms, we established a differentiated technology footprint that supports a growing ecosystem of AI‑enabled applications.
evidence.excerpt: By bringing NPU‑accelerated AI capabilities directly into mainstream x86 platforms, we established a differentiated technology footprint that supports a growing ecosystem of AI‑enabled applications.

evidence.text: Our embedded computing portfolio delivers high-performance, scalable solutions across CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, System-on-Modules (SOMs) and adaptive SoCs for markets such as automotive, industrial, healthcare, storage and networking with integrated AI processing capabilities.
evidence.excerpt: Our embedded computing portfolio delivers high-performance, scalable solutions across CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, System-on-Modules (SOMs) and adaptive SoCs for markets such as automotive, industrial, healthcare, storage and networking with integrated AI processing capabilities.

evidence.text: We develop comprehensive software stacks that include development tools, compilers and drivers to enable our high-performance CPUs, APUs, GPUs and FPGAs.
evidence.excerpt: We develop comprehensive software stacks that include development tools, compilers and drivers to enable our high-performance CPUs, APUs, GPUs and FPGAs.

evidence.text: We have a comprehensive and open AI software stack to support the diverse set of AI ecosystems across frameworks, large and small language models and applications.
evidence.excerpt: We have a comprehensive and open AI software stack to support the diverse set of AI ecosystems across frameworks, large and small language models and applications.

evidence.text: By working closely with customers, we deliver customized solutions that meet their evolving needs, leveraging our broad IP portfolio and leadership in design, integration and advanced packaging.
evidence.excerpt: By working closely with customers, we deliver customized solutions that meet their evolving needs, leveraging our broad IP portfolio and leadership in design, integration and advanced packaging.

evidence.text: Our investments in technologies such as our custom-ready chiplet platform and AMD Infinity Fabric™ switch position us to maintain our leadership as a custom-design silicon provider of choice.
evidence.excerpt: Our investments in technologies such as our custom-ready chiplet platform and AMD Infinity Fabric™ switch position us to maintain our leadership as a custom-design silicon provider of choice.

evidence.text: The product brands for adaptive SoCs include Zynq™ 7000, Zynq UltraScale+™ MPSoC, Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoCs, Versal™ HBM, Versal Premium, Versal Prime, Versal™ AI Core and Versal AI Edge.
evidence.excerpt: Our product brands for adaptive SoCs are Zynq™ 7000, Zynq UltraScale+™ MPSoC, Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoCs, Versal™ HBM, Versal Premium, Versal Prime, Versal™ AI Core and Versal AI Edge.

evidence.text: The software tools for programmable devices are Vitis™, Vitis AI™, and Vivado™ tools.
evidence.excerpt: The software tools for our programmable devices are Vitis™, Vitis AI™, and Vivado™ tools.

evidence.text: The System-on-Module (SOM) product is the Kria™ brand.
evidence.excerpt: Our System-on-Module (SOM) product is the Kria™ brand.

evidence.text: AMD sells low-power versions of AMD Athlon™, AMD Geode™, AMD Ryzen™, AMD EPYC™, AMD R Series and G Series processors as embedded processor solutions.
evidence.excerpt: We also sell low-power versions of our AMD Athlon™, as well as AMD Geode™, AMD Ryzen™, AMD EPYC™, AMD R Series and G Series processors as embedded processor solutions.

evidence.text: Compute and network acceleration board products are sold under the Alveo™ and Pensando™ brands.
evidence.excerpt: Our compute and network acceleration board products are sold under the Alveo™ and Pensando™ brands.

evidence.text: Data Center Segment customers consist primarily of hyperscale data centers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), system integrators and independent distributors.
evidence.excerpt: Our Data Center Segment customers consist primarily of hyperscale data centers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), system integrators and independent distributors in both domestic and international markets.

evidence.text: Client and Gaming Segment customers consist primarily of PC OEMs, independent distributors, and ODMs that manufacture motherboards.
evidence.excerpt: Our Client and Gaming Segment customers consist primarily of PC OEMs, a network of independent distributors and, for chipset products, ODMs that manufacture motherboards.

evidence.text: Embedded Segment products are sold to customers in markets such as aerospace and defense, automotive, industrial, vision and healthcare, communications infrastructure, test and measurement, emulation and prototyping, audio, video and broadcasting and data center.
evidence.excerpt: Our Embedded Segment products are sold to customers in a very wide range of markets such as aerospace and defense, automotive, industrial, vision and healthcare, communications infrastructure, test and measurement, emulation and prototyping, audio, video and broadcasting and data center.

evidence.text: In 2025, net revenue increased 34% to $34.6 billion, compared to $25.8 billion in 2024.
evidence.locator: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS (Item 7), part 1/18
evidence.excerpt: In 2025, we delivered strong annual revenue growth with net revenue increasing 34% to $34.6 billion, compared to $25.8 billion in 2024.

evidence.text: Data Center net revenue of $16.6 billion increased by 32% compared to $12.6 billion in 2024.
evidence.locator: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS (Item 7), part 1/18
evidence.excerpt: Data Center net revenue of $16.6 billion increased by 32% compared to $12.6 billion in 2024, primarily driven by strong demand for our 5th generation AMD EPYC™ processors and AMD Instinct™ MI350 Series GPUs.

evidence.text: Client and Gaming segment net revenue of $14.6 billion in 2025 increased by 51% compared to $9.6 billion in 2024.

evidence.excerpt: Client and Gaming segment net revenue of $14.6 billion in 2025 increased by 51% compared to $9.6 billion in 2024, primarily driven by strong demand for our AMD Ryzen™ processors, semi-custom game consoles SoCs and Radeon™ gaming GPUs.

evidence.text: Embedded net revenue of $3.5 billion decreased by 3% compared to net revenue of $3.6 billion in 2024.
